metadata.title: fix(gateway): avoid mutating ORM gateway auth_value during read conversion
metadata.author: SergioChan

description:
## Summary
- replace remaining `_prepare_gateway_for_read()` call sites with `convert_gateway_to_read()` so gateway reads stop mutating attached ORM instances
- keep `_prepare_gateway_for_read()` deprecated but make it return a prepared copy instead of mutating the original object
- preserve existing auth/tag normalization behavior while eliminating dict→string writeback risk from issue #3540

## Testing
- `python -m compileall -q mcpgateway/services/gateway_service.py`
- `pytest -q tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_gateway_service_helpers.py -k "prepare_gateway_for_read or register_gateway_authheaders_stores_dict_in_db"` *(fails in this environment before tests run: missing `sqlalchemy` dependency)*

## Related
Fixes #3540
